before.requirement: For accepted CBOR bytes 0xf9 0x7e 0x00, the round-trip equality assertion must succeed.
before.reason: The decoder produces NaN, but the old float constructor converts it to null. CBOR serialization and reparsing preserve null, and two null values compare equal.

after.requirement: For accepted CBOR bytes 0xf9 0x7e 0x00, the round-trip equality assertion must succeed.
after.reason: The changed constructor preserves NaN. CBOR serialization emits a double that reparses as NaN; floating-point equality returns false, so the existing assertion fails.

claims.reason: The same old harness succeeds on this witness before g0001 and fails after g0001; the constraint arises from preserving NaN after the change.
